title: Universal property and kernels of adic-integer residue maps
statement: Let $r$ be a prime and let $\mathbf Z_r$ be the valuation ring of $\mathbf Q_r$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers]. Write $\rho_n:\mathbf Z_r\to\mathbf Z/r^n\mathbf Z$ for the canonical unital residue homomorphism, for every integer $n\geq0$, and $c_{a,b}:\mathbf Z/r^b\mathbf Z\to\mathbf Z/r^a\mathbf Z$ for reduction when $a\leq b$. Then $c_{a,b}\circ\rho_b=\rho_a$ and $\ker\rho_n=r^n\mathbf Z_r$. For every commutative unital ring $R$ and family of unital ring homomorphisms $f_n:R\to\mathbf Z/r^n\mathbf Z$ satisfying $c_{a,b}\circ f_b=f_a$ for all $a\leq b$, there exists a unique unital ring homomorphism $f:R\to\mathbf Z_r$ satisfying $\rho_n\circ f=f_n$ for every $n$. For $x,y\in\mathbf Z_r$, equality $\rho_n(x)=\rho_n(y)$ for every $n\geq0$ is equivalent to $x=y$. Finally, for $x\in\mathbf Z_r$ and $n\geq0$, one has $|x|_r\leq r^{-n}$ if and only if $x\in r^n\mathbf Z_r$.
